dialogue.text: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.
dialogue.zh: 我認為人們對莫札特有一種親密感。
dialogue.ja: 人々はモーツァルトに親しみを感じていると思います。
dialogue.local: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.
dialogue.en: I think there's an intimacy that people have with Mozart.

dialogue.text: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.
dialogue.zh: 他們覺得自己認識他，愛他的音樂，珍惜它。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは彼を知っているように感じ、彼の音楽を愛し、大切にしています。
dialogue.local: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.
dialogue.en: They feel like they know him, they love his music, they cherish it.

dialogue.text: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,
dialogue.zh: 沃爾夫岡·阿瑪迪斯·莫札特，是古典音樂中最著名的人物之一，
dialogue.ja: ヴォルフガング・アマデウス・モーツァルトは、クラシック音楽で最も有名な人物の一人です。
dialogue.local: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,
dialogue.en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the most renowned figures in classical music,

dialogue.text: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.
dialogue.zh: 現在成為紐約摩根圖書館和博物館的焦點。
dialogue.ja: 現在、ニューヨークのモーガン図書館・博物館で注目を集めています。
dialogue.local: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.
dialogue.en: is now center stage at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.

dialogue.text: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,
dialogue.zh: 這個展覽是與薩爾茨堡的莫札特基金會合作的，
dialogue.ja: この展示はザルツブルクのモーツァルト基金との共同企画です。
dialogue.local: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,
dialogue.en: The exhibit is a collaboration with the Mozart Ham Foundation in Salzburg,

dialogue.text: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.
dialogue.zh: 奧地利作曲家於1756年出生的地方。
dialogue.ja: オーストリアの作曲家が1756年に生まれた場所です。
dialogue.local: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.
dialogue.en: where the Austrian composer was born in 1756.

dialogue.text: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.
dialogue.zh: 我最想講述的故事是莫札特作為一個人與作為偶像、傳奇之間的橋樑。
dialogue.ja: 私が最も伝えたかったのは、人間としてのモーツァルトと、アイコンや伝説としてのモーツァルトの架け橋の話です。
dialogue.local: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.
dialogue.en: The story I most wanted to tell was that bridge between Mozart, the human being, and Mozart, the icon, the legend.

dialogue.text: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,
dialogue.zh: 羅賓·麥克萊倫是這個展覽的策展人，展覽包含了一系列珍寶，
dialogue.ja: ロビン・マクレランはこの展示のキュレーターで、多くの宝物が含まれています。
dialogue.local: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,
dialogue.en: Robin McClellan is curator of the show, which includes a symphony of treasures,

dialogue.text: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.
dialogue.zh: 例如莫札特最早期的音樂作品，有些是在他只有五歲時創作的。
dialogue.ja: モーツァルトがわずか5歳の時に作った最初期の音楽作品などです。
dialogue.local: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.
dialogue.en: like Mozart's earliest musical works, some created when he was just five years old.

dialogue.text: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.
dialogue.zh: 這些作品是父親親切地為他記錄下來的，因為莫札特當時還太小，甚至無法自己書寫。
dialogue.ja: モーツァルトがまだ小さすぎて自分で書けなかったため、父親が愛情を込めて記録しました。
dialogue.local: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.
dialogue.en: Which is father lovingly noted down for him because Mozart was still too young to even write them himself.

dialogue.text: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.
dialogue.zh: 莫札特並不是家中唯一的神童。
dialogue.ja: モーツァルトだけが家族の中の神童ではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.
dialogue.en: Mozart wasn't the only prodigy in his family.

dialogue.text: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.
dialogue.zh: 展覽還突顯了他較不為人知的姐姐瑪麗亞·安娜，綽號納諾。
dialogue.ja: 展示では、あまり知られていない姉のマリア・アンナ、通称ナノも紹介されています。
dialogue.local: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.
dialogue.en: The exhibit also highlights his lesser known older sister, Maria Ana, nicknamed Nano.

dialogue.text: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.
dialogue.zh: 這是她唯一已知作品的最後一小節，雖然很短小，卻意義非凡。
dialogue.ja: 彼女が書いた唯一の既知の作品の最後の小節で、小さいですが非常に意味深いです。
dialogue.local: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.
dialogue.en: It's the final measure of music in the only known composition that she wrote, and so it's tiny, but incredibly meaningful.

dialogue.text: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,
dialogue.zh: 他的父親萊奧波德·莫札特在某種意義上是個企業家，帶著孩子們巡迴歐洲，留下深刻印象，
dialogue.ja: 彼の父レオポルト・モーツァルトは一種の起業家で、子供たちをヨーロッパ中に連れて回り、大きな印象を残しました。
dialogue.local: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,
dialogue.en: Leopold Mozart, his father, was an entrepreneur in a sense, touring the children around Europe, making a big impression,

dialogue.text: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.
dialogue.zh: 他甚至想出了販售現在所謂周邊商品的點子。
dialogue.ja: そして、今でいうグッズを販売するというアイデアも持っていました。
dialogue.local: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.
dialogue.en: and he even had the idea to sell what we might call merch nowadays.

dialogue.text: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.
dialogue.zh: 這些商品作為紀念品賣給有幸來聽莫札特孩子們表演的人。
dialogue.ja: これは、モーツァルトの子供たちの演奏を聴く幸運な人々にお土産として売られました。
dialogue.local: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.
dialogue.en: This was sold as a souvenir to anyone who was lucky enough to come and hear the Mozart children perform.

dialogue.text: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.
dialogue.zh: 展覽甚至分享了這位年輕作曲家的浪漫生活細節。
dialogue.ja: 展示では若き作曲家の恋愛事情についても紹介しています。
dialogue.local: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.
dialogue.en: The exhibit even shares details about the young composer's romantic life.

dialogue.text: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.
dialogue.zh: 這是一封他21歲時寫給表姐的調情信。
dialogue.ja: これは彼が21歳の時にいとこに宛てた軽い口調の手紙です。
dialogue.local: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.
dialogue.en: Here's a flirtatious letter written at age 21 to his first cousin.

dialogue.text: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.
dialogue.zh: 當時，這種關係並不罕見。
dialogue.ja: 当時、そのような関係は珍しくありませんでした。
dialogue.local: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.
dialogue.en: Back then, that sort of relationship was not uncommon.

dialogue.text: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,
dialogue.zh: 他的信件以廁所幽默和性暗示聞名，所以在信的結尾他對她說，
dialogue.ja: 彼の手紙はトイレジョークや性的なほのめかしで有名で、手紙の終わりに彼は彼女にこう書いています。
dialogue.local: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,
dialogue.en: His letters are famous for bathroom humor and sexual innuendo, so toward the end of the letter he says to her,

dialogue.text: I sign with such affection and love.
dialogue.zh: 我以滿滿的愛意簽名。
dialogue.ja: 私は深い愛情を込めて署名します。
dialogue.local: I sign with such affection and love.
dialogue.en: I sign with such affection and love.

dialogue.text: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.
dialogue.zh: 我吻你的臉、手、膝蓋，還有你願意讓我吻的任何地方。
dialogue.ja: あなたの顔や手、膝、そしてあなたが許すならどこにでもキスします。
dialogue.local: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.
dialogue.en: I kiss you on your face, on your hands, on your knees, and anywhere else you'll let me kiss you.

dialogue.text: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.
dialogue.zh: 此外，莫札特童年時期的小提琴首次在大西洋這邊展出。
dialogue.ja: また、大西洋のこちら側で初めて展示されるモーツァルトの子供時代のバイオリンもあります。
dialogue.local: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.
dialogue.en: Also on display on this side of the Atlantic for the very first time, Mozart's childhood violin.

dialogue.text: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.
dialogue.zh: 還有他用來創作一些最著名歌劇的巧妙和弦。
dialogue.ja: そして、彼が最も評価されたオペラのいくつかを作曲するために使った巧妙な和音も展示されています。
dialogue.local: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.
dialogue.en: And the clever chord he used to compose some of his most acclaimed operas.

dialogue.text: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以看到莫札特作曲時灑出的墨跡，可能是匆忙中同時創作多首作品。
dialogue.ja: ここには、モーツァルトが作曲中にインクをこぼした跡が見えます。おそらく急いでいて、複数の作品を同時に作曲していたのでしょう。
dialogue.local: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.
dialogue.en: Here you see ink spots where Mozart spilled ink as he was composing, probably in a hurry, you know, composing multiple pieces at once.

dialogue.text: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,
dialogue.zh: 其中最美好的一點是這張由他妻子放入巧妙和弦中的便條，
dialogue.ja: これの最も素敵な点の一つは、彼の妻が巧妙な和音の中に入れたこのメモです。
dialogue.local: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,
dialogue.en: One of the most lovely aspects of this actually is this note that was placed into the clever chord by his wife,

dialogue.text: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,
dialogue.zh: 康斯坦扎在他去世後證明了他的真實性，並說，
dialogue.ja: 彼の死後、妻のコンスタンツァが彼の本物であることを証明し、こう書いています。
dialogue.local: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,
dialogue.en: Constanza, after his death, where she attests to his authenticity and says,

dialogue.text: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.
dialogue.zh: 這是我丈夫用來創作《魔笛》、《安魂曲》以及其他許多著名作品的樂器。
dialogue.ja: これは夫が『魔笛』や『レクイエム』、その他多くの有名な作品を作曲するのに使った楽器です。
dialogue.local: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.
dialogue.en: this was the instrument my husband used to compose the magic flute, the requiem, and many other of his most famous pieces.

dialogue.text: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.
dialogue.zh: 莫札特於1791年去世時，正在創作他著名的《安魂曲》。
dialogue.ja: モーツァルトは1791年に亡くなる時、『レクイエム』の作曲に取り組んでいました。
dialogue.local: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.
dialogue.en: Mozart was working on his famous requiem when he died in 1791.

dialogue.text: He was just 35.
dialogue.zh: 他當時只有35歲。
dialogue.ja: 彼はわずか35歳でした。
dialogue.local: He was just 35.
dialogue.en: He was just 35.

dialogue.text: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.
dialogue.zh: 他英年早逝，人們開始越來越意識到他是多麼罕見且了不起的作曲家，這也成為我們今天所知的傳奇。
dialogue.ja: 彼は若くして亡くなりましたが、人々は彼がどれほど稀有で素晴らしい作曲家であったかを次第に理解し、それが今日知られる伝説となりました。
dialogue.local: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.
dialogue.en: He died young, people began to realize more and more what a rare and incredible composer he was, and that became the legend that we know today.

dialogue.text: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.
dialogue.zh: 這個傳奇由其他古典音樂大師如蕭邦、孟德爾頌和貝多芬共同錘煉，幫助提升了莫札特的遺產。
dialogue.ja: ショパン、メンデルスゾーン、ベートーヴェンなどの他のクラシック音楽の偉人たちがモーツァルトの遺産をさらに輝かせました。
dialogue.local: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.
dialogue.en: A legend burnished by other classical music greats, Chopin, Mendelssohn, and Beethoven all helped enhance Mozart's legacy.

dialogue.text: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.
dialogue.zh: 沃爾夫岡·阿瑪迪斯·莫札特，短暫而多彩的人生，留下至今仍迴響的作品。
dialogue.ja: ヴォルフガング・アマデウス・モーツァルト、多くの幕を持つ短い人生で、今日まで響き続ける作品群を残しました。
dialogue.local: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.
dialogue.en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a short life in many acts with a body of work that resonates to this day.

dialogue.text: I'll see you next time.
dialogue.zh: 下次見。
dialogue.ja: また次回お会いしましょう。
dialogue.local: I'll see you next time.
dialogue.en: I'll see you next time.
